Method of Attack: Exploiting Siri's ability to send SMS messages on locked iOS devices to intercept and reply to payment confirmation codes without unlocking the device
Sending 'Start' SMS to activate service on victim's phone
Submitting charge requests and using Siri to retrieve six-digit confirmation codes
Brute forcing six-digit codes with time-based retry limits
Sending multiple charge requests to multiple victims to improve brute force success
Reply-to-pay functionality exploit allowing payment without unlocking device
Impacted Systems: Apple iOS devices with Siri enabled (iOS 9 default)
Attack Vector: SMS message interception and reply via Siri on locked iOS devices
Social engineering via SMS charge requests
